mel_output, mel_length, alignment = tacotron2.encode_text(text_input)
waveforms = hifi_gan.decode_batch(mel_output)

output_path = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav", delete=False).name
torchaudio.save(output_path, waveforms.squeeze(1).cpu(), 22050)

return output_path
inference.setup:
import torchaudio
import tempfile
import os
from speechbrain.inference.TTS import Tacotron2
from speechbrain.inference.vocoders import HIFIGAN

DEVICE = "cuda" if torchaudio.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

tacotron2 = Tacotron2.from_hparams(
    source="speechbrain/tts-tacotron2-ljspeech",
    savedir=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "tmpdir_tts"),
    run_opts={"device": DEVICE}
)
hifi_gan = HIFIGAN.from_hparams(
    source="speechbrain/tts-hifigan-ljspeech",
    savedir=os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "tmpdir_vocoder"),
    run_opts={"device": DEVICE}
)

model.author: speechbrain
model.description: Text-to-Speech (TTS) with SpeechBrain using a Tacotron2 pretrained on LJSpeech.
model.name: TTS Tacotron2 LJSpeech
